releaseNotes: SOLVE OOS is now planner-grade: every solver-created relationship is selected by the PlannerLogicEvaluator (graph locality, WBS proximity, shared activity codes, schedule-date proximity, language-neutral name tokens) instead of raw Activity ID order.
Every added relationship carries an explanation and a HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW planner-confidence classification, summarized in the result and reviewable in the new solver-created-logic grid.
Project-wide fallbacks are last resort, explicitly explained, and flagged for planning review; new NETWORK CONCENTRATION REVIEW flags mark heavy fan-in candidates.
Report fixes: human Case numbering (no zero-based leak), no duplicated wording, Data date surfaced from the XER with the project Retained Logic / Progress Override mode.
P6 F9 acceptance contract added to the report; validated against a real P6 post-F9 export (all solver logic survives).
No changes to the updater, installer, registration, or the P6 Classic / P6 Soft visual languages.
